app_info.subtitle: Audit WebMCP readiness
app_info.description: isWebMCP examines bounded public-page source evidence, identifies candidate agent actions, audits sanitized WebMCP tool contracts, and explains what additional runtime evidence is required before claiming readiness or measured lift.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stores a privacy-safe audit-attempt record and an ephemeral report while analyzing the selected public page.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches public source but does not publish, submit, or otherwise change public internet or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, transact, or perform another irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a short-lived internal report record for the labeled synthetic sample.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses an internal synthetic fixture and does not change public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, transact, or perform another irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a short-lived derived report from sanitized contract metadata supplied by the user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Processes contract metadata within the service and does not change public or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, transact, or perform another irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns a static explanation without creating or updating data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not access or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, transact, or perform another irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Show the synthetic report before auditing a live page.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me a sample isWebMCP audit so I can understand the evidence model.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a clearly labeled synthetic report with actionability, evidence labels, findings, limitations, and next steps.

test_cases.description: Audit a simple public page using bounded source evidence.
test_cases.user_prompt: Audit https://example.com for WebMCP readiness and explain the strongest evidence.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a source-only report for example.com and explicitly withholds runtime readiness and measured lift.

test_cases.description: Reject a local-network target without fetching it.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a safe validation error explaining that private or local targets cannot be audited.

test_cases.description: Explain the distinction between source and runtime evidence.
test_cases.user_prompt: What is the difference between source actionability and runtime readiness?
test_cases.expected_output: Explains the requested evidence level and states the evidence required to support it.

test_cases.description: Audit a sanitized contract after a source scan.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using the scan report I just created, audit this sanitized WebMCP contract: name search_products, description Search the public catalog, inputSchema with a query string, readOnlyHint true, and verification Product results are shown.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an imported-contract audit tied to the active scan and labels the contract evidence as not independently verified.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for unrelated calendar work.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because calendar access is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app to modify a third-party website.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Log in to this website and submit its contact form for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because it performs source analysis and does not authenticate, submit forms, or mutate target sites.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for unsupported private-code review.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Review my private repository and fix every security vulnerability.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because it audits public web-page evidence and sanitized WebMCP contracts, not private repositories.
